title.en: Keep Two Dots and Refine Their Edges

brief.zh: 让白色圆点数保持不变，再用模糊和阈值处理改变它们的边缘。
brief.en: Keep the number of white dots fixed while blur and thresholding change their edges.

concept.zh: 相同的连通区域数可以对应不同的总面积。
concept.en: The same number of connected regions can cover different total areas.

hints.zh: 原来的两个圆有 9150 个白色像素。试试 7 × 7 模糊，再把阈值调整到 160 左右。
hints.en: The original two dots occupy 9,150 white pixels. Try 7 × 7 blur and tune the threshold around 160.

label.zh: 同时控制区域数和面积
label.en: Control region count and area together

prompt.zh: 保持 2 个白色区域，同时把白色像素总数调到 8580 至 8680。
prompt.en: Keep two white regions and tune the total white pixel count to 8,580–8,680.
